responsibility: This machine description defines the DFA scheduler model for the Broadcom XLP processor family. It describes four integer execution pipes, separate integer divide and floating-point/divide-sqrt resources, completion ports, and reservations for branches, loads/stores, ALU operations, condition moves, HI/LO access, integer multiply/divide, FP arithmetic, fused multiply-add, complex FP divide/sqrt classes, atomics, and synchronization loops, allowing GCC to schedule both ordinary code and XLP-specific atomic sequences to this wide multicore pipeline.
